ODismemberment: BSTempEffectParticle loads model data through the shared ModelLoader, then either asks TES for a cached clone or clones the loaded object directly.

BloodOnDeath decode 2026-05-30: particle temp-effect duration is overwritten with the max controller span found in the cloned particle NIF tree. Visual squirt lifetime is model/controller-driven, not fDecalLifetime:Display.
BloodOnDeath decode 2026-05-30: first atan2-like angle is based on horizontal length sqrt(dirX^2+dirY^2) and dirZ; stored negated as pitch for the particle model orientation.
BloodOnDeath decode 2026-05-30: second atan2-like angle is horizontal yaw from normalized dirY/dirX. More outward squirt should feed a stronger horizontal direction before this constructor.
BloodOnDeath decode 2026-05-30: builds the particle local rotation matrix from yaw, zero middle rotation, and pitch; direction is orientation-only here, no additional outward force is applied.
